summary: The registrant filed an 8-K reporting a Joint Development and License Agreement with Kopin Corporation. The agreement involves collaboration on GPU-to-GPU connectivity technology, with the registrant paying up to $15 million for development through successful prototype demonstrations. An initial $5 million purchase order is due within 10 business days. No specific price per share, premium, or deal terms for a special situation are present. The filing covers routine contractual and governance matters, including board changes and equity sales, but no special situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or strategic review is indicated.
